tei:div.tei:p: (ma)༄༅// chos kyi rje kun dga' rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen ye shes nyi ma cher 'bar ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas blo'i mkha' las mi 'da' yang*// dbang po'i rim bzhin rang dang 'tshams pa'i skur// ston mdzad bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang 'dir/ bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi sprul pa'i sku rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dngos su dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i slob dpon mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ zhes mtshan nyi ma ltar grags pa de'i thugs kyi nying khu/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag ces mtshan du gsol ba de ni/ snyan brgyud bzhi dang*/ tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas bla mas bshad cing gtan la phab pa de/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma lam rim gyis pa dang*/ cig char ba gang yang rung bas nyams su blang bar bya ba yin gyi/ bzhi tshan gnyis po gang yang rung ba la ma ltos par/ bla mas bshad pa dang*/ slob mas nyams su blang bar bya ba nyid du rung ba ma yin par/ brgyud pa'i rim pa dag las legs par 'ongs pa'i phyir na/ gangs can du byon pa'i gdams pa gzhan dang gzhan ci rigs pa dag las khyad par du 'phags so// snyan rgyud bzhi dang*/ tshad ma bzhi po'i rtsa ba yang bla ma tshad mar gyur pa nyid med na mi 'byung bas na/ chos 'di'i bshad sgrub kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa dag thog mar tshad ma nyid du yid ches par bya ba la 'grus pa mi lhod par mdzad do// de bas na phyi ma'i dus 'dir/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag nyin mo'i dbang phyug lta bur gyur nas/ sgrub pa po skar ma'i tshogs tsam gsal bar bskrun pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rje btsun dam pa ā nan+da bha tra'i zhal snga nas yin la/ rje de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo dam par gyur nas/

sgrub rgyud chu bo'i rgyun ji bzhin pa des/ bskal bzang slob ma'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa dag rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgya mtsho chen por ro gcig pa nyid du mdzad pa po ni/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes/ mtshan nyi ma ltar grags pa de yin no// rje bla ma dam pa sras dang bcas pa de gnyis ka'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng*/ rnyog pa med pa/ spyi bos gus par blangs nas/ gdams pa 'di'i lugs kyi rtsa ba'i bka' dang*/ bstan bcos kyi gzhung dang*/ man ngag gi 'khrid tshul cha lag dang bcas pa rab tu gyur pa gsan nas/ dus yun ring por dben pa'i gnas rab tu mang por/ lo'i grangs gnyis tshan dang*/ gsum tshan la sogs pa'i dus kyis rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad cing*/ slar yang bshad sgrub spel mas 'gro ba rab tu mang po smin par mdzad cing*/ bshad sgrub kyi rgyud pa 'dzin par nus pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mang po dag smin cing grol bar mdzad pa po ni/ rje btsun chos kyi rje kun dga' rdo rje zhes mtshan rnam par dkar ba de nyid do// 'di nyid kyi rnam dkar gyi phrin las dang mdzad pa mdo tsam du brjod pa la gsum ste/ thog mar mngon mtho'i go 'phang brnyes nas bsod nams lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul/ nges par legs pa'i lam la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin pas ye shes kyi tshogs ji ltar bsgrubs pa/ rang rgyud smin cing grol nas gzhan don phrin las ji ltar mdzad pa'o// dang po ni/ sngon nyid nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa che zhing*/ rnam par dkar ba'i smon lam gyi mthu phyin ci ma log par grub pa/ byang chub kyi sems bskal pa du mar sbyangs pa dang ldan pa dag ni/ spyir du na/ yul ljongs dge mtshan dang ldan pa dag dang*/ de yang rigs mtho zhing cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba la gegs med cing*/ mthun pa'i rkyen 'dod dgu'i nyid du 'byor pa dang*/

log pa'i bshes gnyen dang mi phrad cing*/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin pa gegs med pa'i sa phyogs dag tu skye ba 'dzin pa dang*/ de'i mthus sa phyogs der dge mtshan dpag tu med pa 'byung ba ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos nyid do// de'i nang nas 'di pa'i rigs ni/ sngon gyi dus nyid nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mang po dag dang*/ yul ljongs kyi gtso bo dang*/ sde pa so so ba dag gi bdag por gyur pa dag mang du byung ba'i rus chen rma zhes bya'o// de'i rigs las phyis byon pa ni bka' gdams kyi khri dpon don grub rgyal mtshan la rgya ma se tu zhes grags/ de'i sras bar pa rdo rje snying po zhes pa/ rje bla mas mtshan du btag pa de la/ sras dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri rab lta bur gyur pa gnyis dang*/ khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsum ste/ lnga tshar zhig byon pa las/ bar pa drung dge slong nam mkha' mchog grags zhes/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos mtshan du btags pa de dang*/ yum dpal mchog mtsho mo zhes bya ba/ sgyer gyi gdung 'dzin chen po rin chen bzang po'i sras/ gzhis kha bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon dpal ldan chos skyong gi sras su gyur pa ste/ yab dang yum de gnyis las sras dge ba'i bshes gnyen gser gyi mchod sdong lta bur gyur pa gsum pa dang*/ sde'i bdag po yul ljongs pa kun gyis ma sangs mched gnyis zhes/ bstod bkur gyi gnas su gyur pa dag dang*/ lnga tshar zhig 'khrungs pa las/ rje 'di ni shing pho 'brug gi lo pa/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa tsam gyis/ yab yum gyi thugs la dga' bdes khyab pa dang*/ dgun shing rtsi kha 'bu ba dang*/ me tog 'char ba dang*/ yum gyi rmi lam du nyi ma 'char ba la sogs pa ltas khyad par can gyi sgo nas/ skar ma rgyal dang bcas pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la 'khrungs so// sras 'di bltams pa nas bzung ste/

spyir yang sde pa 'di la pha rol gyi 'tshe ba med pa dang*/ nang du 'byor pa 'phel ba dang*/ phyi'i mi mthun phyogs gnon pa dang*/ lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du zhal ngo la rkyen sgo chod pa 'byung ngo*// zhes gsung ngo*// khyad par du yang sras rang la dmigs pa'i rkyen gos dang*/ 'tsho ba'i rkyen gzhan las ches bzang ba 'bad med du 'byung zhing*/ dper na gsol mar la dmigs pa'i 'o ma phru ba gang la mar phru ba gang byung ba dang*/ lan gcig bu rdzi yengs pas g.yang la lhung ba rlung gis btegs pa lta bur byung yang lhas bzung bar nges pa dang*/ bzhengs nus tsam nas/ lha sku dang*/ glegs bam dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can kho na la dga' zhing rtse bar mdzad pa dang*/ gzhon nu rang gi gos chung ngu 'ga' zhig sham thabs dang*/ la la chos gos yin zer ba dang*/ rtsed mo'i grogs rnams chos nyan du byed pa sogs la dpag nas/ yab yum gyis rab tu byung ba nyid du bsngo bgrang mdzad cing*/ 'tsho ba'i rkyen dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' la 'os pa dag kho nas 'tsho bar mdzad do// de nas rim gyis rang lo bdun pa la/ yi ge pa'i slob dpon gyis/ chos kyi ma mo klog thabs kyi rim pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa la bslab sbyang mdzad/ de nas rang lo bcu pa la/ nyid kyi khu bo dus de tsam na sa lugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed pa'i bla mar gyur pa/ spyan snga chos kyi rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas mkhan po dang*/ de'i cung spyan snga phun tshogs dpal bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan can mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mang po dang*/ rigs pa'i gnas du ma la rigs shing grol bar gyur pa'i spobs pa can des las byed pa'i slob dpon mdzad nas/ dge bsnyen nas dge tshul gyi bar du grub par mdzad/ de nas gnas kyi slob dpon ni/ rgyal lha khang dang*/ chos grwa bde ba can gyi bshad nyan pa chen po phun tshogs pas mdzad de/

thog mar tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel la bslab sbyangs dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel la/ rgyal ba blo gros seng ges mdzad pa'i tshig don dang*/ spyi don gyi sgo nas sgrin 'grus che bar mdzad/ rang lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i tshe/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa rong chen/ mkhar rtse bas spyan drangs te phebs/ nā len+d+ra'i dgon pa phul/ bstan pa'i rin po che spyi dgos thams cad nyi ma shar ba lta bur gyur/ de nas bzung ste rang lo bcu bdun bzhes kyi bar du gnas kyi slob dpon dang bcas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa de'i drung du/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel/ mdo sde'i rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ bshes pa'i spring yig gzhan yang chos phran mang du gsan/ rje nyid kyis thal phreng gi rtsi bzhag yan mdzad nas/ lung ra chen mo'i sgrigs su zhugs nas lan 'debs par mdzad do// rang lo bco brgyad pa la khu bo rnam pa gnyis/ kha skong gi dge slong nyi shu dag dang bcas pa las bsnyen par rdzogs shing*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa las 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud rdzogs par gsan/ dus der khu bo'i drung du/ dgyes pa rdo rje man ngag dang 'grel pa lugs gnyis kyi dbang gsan nas/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ dkyil 'khor cho ga rnam pa gnyis/ kun rig bu lugs dang bcas pa'i gsan sbyong dang*/ gsung ngag rin po che yan lag rdzogs/ u rgyan pa'i bsnyen bsgrub yan lag drug pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang cha lag dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang chos skyong che chung*/ rnam rgyal 'joms sogs rjes gnang phran mang po dang*/ gzhan yang khrid phran mang du gsan/ rang gi khu bo gnyis po'i drung du'ang*/ phar phyin rtsa 'grel rgyal bgros kyi steng nas dang*/ nyi khri le'u brgyad ma/ sa sde lnga/ bka' gdams lam rim/ pu to ba'i dpe chos sogs gsan pa rgya che zhing thugs rgyud la smin par mdzad do// skabs der spyan snga rin po che dben pa'i gnas su bzhugs/

de'i gcung phun tshogs pa glang ri thang gi gdan sar phebs pa nas/ rang lo bcu dgu pa la rgyal lha khang gi gdan sar phebs spyan snga'i mtshan gsol/ thog mar lha khang gi gdan sa lo lnga dang*/ glang ri thang nyis sbrag lo gsum ste gdan sa lo brgyad mdzad/ de skabs su khu bo gong ma gnyis bde bar gshegs rjes/ gcung blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gdan sa gong 'og gtod pa mdzad nas/ 'od gsal rtse mor sgrub pa lo gnyis mdzad/ skabs der rgya ma rin po che gzhon nu 'od pa'i drung du/ sems tsam lugs kyi cho gas byang chub sems dpa' sdom pa yang dag par blangs/ nā ro'i chos drug dang*/ phyag chen lnga ldan gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes/ bka' gdams kyi bstan rin chen mo dang*/ bka' gdams thor bu ba la sogs pa rgya ma'i chos skyong sogs dang mang du gsan no// mdor na skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ sngon bskal pa mang por thugs kyis gtong ba la mngon par dga' zhing ser sna med pa dang*/ gzhan la phrag dog med cing skye bo mtha' dag la byams pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag par bsten pa la spro zhing*/ rab tu byung ba dag mthong ba tsam gyis dges pa ni sngon gzhon nur gyur pa'i dus nyid nas yin la/ phyis bstan pa rin po che la zhugs shing*/ thugs rgyud sbyong bar mdzad pa'i thog ma nyid nas kyang dul ba dang*/ yang dag par sdom pa dang*/ chos spyod kyi rim pa mtha' dag la ngang gis gzhol ba dang*/ mang du gsan pa tshol ba la mngon par spro ba dang*/ mkhas grub kyi bshes gnyen bsten par 'os pa dag gang na bzhugs zhes yongs su rtog cing*/ tshol ba la 'grus par mdzad do// de dag la 'di skad ces/ chen po rnams ni rigs mtho dang*// dge zhing gtsang la 'byor pa che// chos la bar chad med gnas su// smon lam dbang gi skye ba 'dzin// de nas ri rab lta bu yi// dge ba'i bshes la bsnyen byas nas// theg gsum po la rim pa bzhin// zhugs nas rgyal sras chen por mtshon// de nas rang lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i tshe/

mkhas btsun bzang po'i khri la g.yo ba med bzhin du/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam dkar gyi tshogs sngon nyid nas yang dang yang du gsan zhing*/ dgongs pa'i dbang gis skyes bu skom pa rab tu bsil ba'i chu dwangs pa la snyog pa ltar/ lam phrang gi dka' tshegs nyes dmigs phyi bshol ba mang po dag gi dbang du ma thal bar/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon gnas su bar chad med par phebs nas/ rje rin po che de nyid kyi zhabs kyi rdul phran yang dag par blangs nas lo gsum gyi bar du bsten par mdzad do// skabs su thog mar dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang*/ dges pa rdo rje 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang gi cho gas sdom pa gong ma gnyis yang dag par len par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel pa'i dbang bskur nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam dang*/ zab chos kyi rjes gnang rab tu mang po dang*/ gsung ngag rin po che gzhung bshad kyi bar rgyas par gsan zhing*/ de skabs kyi rgyab chos su sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum/ sdom pa nyi shu pa rtsa 'grel/ sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs kyi rnam par bshad pa 'phros don mang po dang bcas pa gsan/ skabs der kho char byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i drung du 'dul ba lung dang*/ rgyud 'bum la sogs pa'i lung mang du gsan/ lo gsum pa la phyir phebs pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyis yun ring por byin gyis rlabs shing bcangs pa'i snam sbyar/ rdo rje dril bu/ rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams gtso bor smos pa'i 'bul gnang mang po dang*/ khri mthon po la bzhugs su gsol nas/ dbus phyogs su bstan pa spyi dgos kyi khur khyer shig pa'i rten 'brel dang rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ dus der slad ma'ang zhabs drung du phebs pa'i dam bca' phul nas/

de bzhin gyi rten 'brel 'grig pa'i smon lam mang po gnang*/ de nas rim gyis phebs pa'i lam du/ rong ri lung phug gi bla ma la rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'brel pa'i dbang bskur rnam grangs kha cig gsan pa sogs mdzad nas/ yang 'od gsal rtse mo'i dben gnas su sku mtshams dam po zla ba bco brgyad du bsdams nas/ sgrub pa rtse gcig pa la gzhol ba mdzad/ de skabs nas slob ma'i tshogs ci rigs pa la dbang dang*/ mngon dkyil gyi mdzub khrid dang*/ rgyud 'bum la sogs pa'i lung mang rab mdzad cing*/ gtso bor ni bde dgyes dang 'brel ba'i thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor/ chos spyod rab gsal nas 'byung ba'i rim pa rnams la/ rang gi khu bo gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin mi g.yel bar mdzad do// de nas rang lo so gnyis pa phag lo'i hor zla dang po la/ phyag phyi ba gzhung ma la rgyus med du khams pa'i dge bshes bzhi tsam phyag phyir khrid nas shul bde bar e waṃ du phebs/ gsung ngag rin po che rgyas pa/ sngon ma gsan pa'i cha lag phran dang*/ gzhan yang zab mo'i chos mang dag dang*/ sgro 'dogs gcod rgyu 'ga' zhig zhus lan gyi tshul du gtan la phab pa yin gsungs/ phag lo'i hor zla bdun pa de spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan pa e waṃ du phebs pa de byung*/ lo rting ma byi lo hor zla bzhi pa la rje rdo rje 'chang 'og min du gshegs/ chos rje mus pa gdan sar phebs pa la chos 'brel mdzad nas gsung chos thog tsam gsan phyir glang thang du gzims spyil du phebs nas/ thugs dam gyi rim pa las ma g.yos bzhin du/ slob ma'i tshogs la nyan bshad kyi rim pa mang du mdzad/ de nas rang lo sum cu so bdun pa la sku mched gnyis ka dpon slob mang po dag dang bcas te/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i rnam par thar pas thugs rab tu phrogs shing*/ mngon par dad nas mus bde ba can du phebs/ sngon gsan pa dang thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i chos rnams la nan chags dang*/

phyag tu blang ba'i rim pa dang*/ rje gong ma rnams kyis gdul bya smin grol mdzad pa'i phyag len gyi rim pa la sgro 'dogs bcad/ gnas der bdag chen chu mig pa'i drung du bsgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ bka' 'bum dag gi lung sogs mang du gsan/ lo gnyis su gdan chags te bar chad mi mnga' bar dbus su phebs nas dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i dben gnas so so ba mang por bshad bsgrub spel ba mdzad do// yang gtsang nas lan thog ma de phyir phebs pa'i skabs shig tu/ gong mas paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen spyan drangs pa la mjal du phebs/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma zhig gi dbang dang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa gsan/ skabs der mkhan chen gzhon nu dpal ba la lam 'bras dpe mdzod ma dang*/ 'dul ba rgya che 'grel gyi lung gsan/ yang gtsang nas lan gnyis pa phyir phebs pa'i skabs der/ ru mtshams nas/ stag lung ka bzhi par grags pa de glang ri thang du spyan drangs/ bla ma de ni sngon ne'u thog dang*/ bde ba can/ skyor lung sogs su ka chen bzhi la sbyangs pa mthar phyin/ e waṃ chos ldan dgon pa 'debs pa'i thog ma nyid nas chos mang du gsan/ zhwa lu'i bla ma so so la bu lugs kyi chos skor mtha' dag gsan/ ru mtsho kha'i sku zhang chos rje dang*/ shangs pa kun mkhyen sogs las dbang bskur mang po gsan pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud rtsa 'grel la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa zhig yin/ bla ma des bu lugs dang*/ rje bla ma dam pa'i sgrub dkyil so so'i steng nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang lan gnyis su mdzad pa de gsan/ bla ma 'dis rje rdo rje 'chang la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dbang rdzogs pa mkhan chen phyogs las pa'i sgrub dkyil dang*/ rje bla ma dam pa'i lugs gnyis ka gsan par 'dug bla ma des glang thang gzhal yas khang du/ bsdus pa'i rgyud thugs kyi thog nas dang*/ 'grel chen la bu lugs kyi mchan dang sa bcad/ mdor bsdus dang po'i rnam bshad chos 'byung dang bcas pa/

chos tshan rnams cha tshang bar/ chos rje sku mched kyis thog drangs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lnga bcu tsam la rgyas pa dang*/ rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i ṭīka chen gyi lung rnams gsungs pa gsan/ gsang 'dus rgyud dang*/ sgron gsal gyi rnam bshad mtha' drug rab gsal zhes pa sogs/ khong pa la mnga' ba'i gsang 'dus kyi bshad pa mang rab gsan/ dbang rdo rje phreng ba kri ya sa muts+tsha'i lugs su mdzad pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa'i gzhung bzhin gsan/ nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dbang nyi shu rtsa gcig tshang ba dang*/ rngog lugs dkyil 'khor bdun/ 'khor lo sdom chen dang*/ sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis/ lwa ba pa dang*/ mai tri pa'i bcu gsum ma sogs mang du gsan/ gzhan yang bdag chen blo gros pa'i drung du/ bsam mi khyab dang*/ phyag chen yi ge med pa sogs lam skor rnams gsan zhing*/ e waṃ gyi gdan sa gsum pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i drung du/ gtso bor ni dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum po mtha' chod par gsan/ bdag po mthu stobs dbang phyug glang thang du spyan drangs/ chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang*/ sgrub skor rgyas pa dur khrod bdag po/ bdud rgyal/ dkar mo nyi zla/ sa phur gyi chos skor rnams gsan te/ rgyas par ni gsan yig nyid du blta bar bya'o// de dag ni mngon par mtho ba'i go 'phangs brnyes nas nges par legs pa'i chos la bslab sbyang ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul gyis ye shes brnyes pa'i tshul mdo tsam du brjod zin nas/ gsum pa rang rgyud smin cing grol nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la bgyi ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ slob ma'i tshogs la chos kyi gsung tshul brjod nas/ zhar la rlabs po che'i bgyi ba ji ltar mdzad pa/ brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bu slob ji ltar byung tshul brjod nas mthar phyin pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar can kha cig mdo tsam du smos pa'o// dang po ni/ skyes bu dam pa 'dis chos gsungs pa'i thog ma ni/

chos grwa gong 'og gnyis su bshad ston dang rnam gzhag rgya chen po mdzad pa'i stengs su/ rgyal lha khang gi dbyar dgun gyi chos dus gnyis/ dpyid ka bra bo sgang sogs su chos gzhi bteg pa dang gsum po la/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel/ rgyal pa'i bgros kyi stengs nas yongs su rdzogs pa tshar re song ngo zhes pa lo grangs bdun brgyad dang*/ glang thang du chos dus gnyis pa la/ phar phyin mkhyen gsum tsam re dang*/ skyes rabs/ dpe chos/ blo sbyong rnams gsung pa lo bzhi tsam dang*/ dgon yan phyin gyi sgrub mchod kyi gral dbu/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du lo grangs du mar mdzad/ skabs der glang thang du spyan snga rin po che gong ma bde bar gshegs pa'i nang rten rje btsun byams pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho bcu gsum pa/ gtsug lag khang ka chen bzhi tog dang bcas pa rgyas par bsgrubs/ rab tu gnas pa chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad/ lha'i me tog gi char zhag grangs mang por phebs/ mar gyi me tog bkram pa'i shing skam po rlan dang bral ba la/ yal ga rlon pa khru gang tsam gnyis 'khrungs/ gzims spyil du zhugs dus lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gser sku nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam dang*/ bris sku grangs las 'das pa dang*/ rje btsun gong ma mtha' dag gi bka' 'bum sogs gsung rab dpag tu med pa bzhengs/ rab tu gnas pa dang rnam gzhag rgya chen po yang yang mdzad/ dgon gong 'og gnyis kyi gdan sa gtad rjes su/ spyir chos gsan pa rgya che mod/ 'phan yul dang*/ dbu ru stod smad kyi gnas so so ba mang po rnams su dbang bskur/ rjes gnang*/ khrid bka' che chung so so ba/ mdo sngags kyi bka' dang bstan bcos mang po'i lung*/ bla ma gong ma'i bka' 'bum so so'i lung bshad rnams rgya cher mdzad pas/ mnga' ris dang dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi slob ma'i tshogs rab tu mang po dag rjes su bzung zhing*/

phan thogs pa zab cing rgya che bas bstan pa'i gsal byed rab tu mang po dang*/ mi che dgu kun gyi bla na rab tu gnas par gyur to// de nas rang lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum pa me mo phag gi lo la/ sngon rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis lung bstan pa bzhin/ shrī na len+d+ra'i khri thog tu spyan drangs te phebs so// gdan sa der lo drug bzhugs pa'i chos dus gnyis po la/ snga chos dang phyi chos gnyis ka rgyan rtsa 'grel/ rnam bshad tshig don rab tu gsal ba'i spyi don dang gzhung don mtha' dag thugs la chub par mdzad nas tshar re gsungs/ gsung ngag rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa/ gsan mkhan mang dus stong zin dang*/ nyung dus su'ang drug brgya yan la tshar re ma chag pa gsungs shing*/ nyung shos la dgos pa'i dbang gis res 'ga' tshar gnyis gsum re gsung ba'ang mdzad/ de dag gi bar mtshams su dbang bka' dang rjes gnang*/ bshad bka' dang bshad lung*/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs rgyun mi chad du mdzad pas/ mdor na gdan sar ji snyed bzhugs pa'i ring la sku mtshams dam par bsdams pa sogs so dal gyi bgyi ba gang yang ma mdzad do// de skabs su dngul gdung rin po che sngar bzhugs pa de la bzo bcos su mdzad de/ rgyu dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs pa dang*/ nyag bre shes rab dpal gyis bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur dgon par 'bul ba'i zhal ta dang gnang sbyin mdzad nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ zang zing gi longs spyod char bzhin du bab pa rnams/ spyir bla ma dang dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ chos 'brel zhus pa rnams la zla dus kyi mchod 'bul/ bstan pa'i gsal byed du gyur pa'i 'chad nyan pa rnams la gnang sbyin/ blo gsal ba'i don gnyer ba rnams la bsngo ba grangs du ma phyag len mdzad cing*/ khyad par du bcu bzhi'i dus chen sngar srol las rgya dpangs bstod pa dang bde dgyes gsang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ gsang sngags 'dzin pa brgya lhag tsam gyis bsgrub mchod/

zhag sbrel du mdzad pa sogs kyi srol tshugs par mdzad do// gdan sa der gdan chags ring la dus bde zhing*/ 'khrug pa med/ grwa rgyun dang longs spyod kyi tshogs rgyas shing*/ dam pa'i chos 'phel bar mdzad/ 'brug gi lo la chos rje gung ru ba'i phyag tu gdan sa gtad/ gzims khang na sngar med kyi thab chas dang gdan cha sogs/ gdan sa na rim gyi rgyun la phan pa'i dgongs pa mdzad/ de nas kyang lo lnga'i bar du bshad bsgrub spel mar mdzad de/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che rkyang pa'ang tshar nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam gsungs par grags so// gnyis pa rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma ji ltar byung ba ni/ gong du ji skad smos pa de ltar chos kyi rnam grangs gsungs pa rnams nyan nas rang gi rgyud smin par byas pa'i slob ma 'jig rten phal pa grangs las 'das pa rnams lta ci smos/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la legs par rab tu byung nas/ lta bas bkar btags pa bzhi dang*/ spyod pas bkar btags pas rgyud yongs su smin par byas pa'i slob ma ni 'bum phrag gi grangs las kyang brgal bar mngon te/ thog ma rgyal lha khang gi mkhan por phebs pa nas bzung nas/ dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa de srid kyi bar la bsgrub bya gzhan dag dge bsnyen dang*/ bsnyen gnas dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga'i srol gnyis la brten nas/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos bla ma so so'i gsung 'bum gyi lung tsam nyan pa ni bgrangs ba las 'das shing*/ de dag gis kyang rang rang so so'i gnas su blo nus dang 'tshams par sdom rgyud dang lung rgyun 'dzin pa ni mngon sum dang lkog tu gyur par shin tu mang po dag yod par nges shing*/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi cho gas yongs su smin par gyur nas/ khrid phran so so ba dag gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa lta ci smos/ gsung ngag rin po che tshar de tsam zhig gsungs pa la'ang*/

slob ma'i grangs ni phal cher brgya tsam las lhag pa nges pa la gsungs shing*/ nyan pa po de dag gis/ bod dang bod chen gyi yul khams so so ba rnams su/ ma mtha' thun bzhi tshun chad kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par byed cing*/ rang rang gi blo nus dang phan sems dang 'tshams par/ slob ma dang nying slob tu gyur pa dag la brgyud pa 'dzin du 'jug par nges pas so// dper na dbus gtsang gi dgon phran so so ba'i bla ma dang*/ bshad nyan pa dang*/ dbon po dang*/ yid rab tu gzhung pa gzhan yang mang po dag lta ci smos/ shrī nā len+d+ra rkyang pa'i nyan bshad pa dus der gsung ngag gsan pa rnams kyis deng sang yang gsung ngag gi brgyud pa bzung zhing*/ zla dus kyi mchod pa 'bul bar mngon sum gyis grub pa bzhin no// de nas mthar phyin pa'i dus kyi mdzad pa la/ ngo mtshar can dngos dang*/ rjes kyi mdzad pa rnams ji ltar grub pa'o// dang po ni/ slar yang chos rje gung ru gshegs rjes su/ shrī nā len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang gi khyams chen por gsung ngag rin po che yongs su rdzogs par gsungs pa grub pa'i nyin/ mchod gtor rgya chen po bshams/ tshogs pa la dga' ston dang rnam bzhag mdzad/ me tog gi char chen po babs/ bka' zhal mdzad pa la/ rang re chos rgya cher 'chad pa da res yan chod tsam yin/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa ni e waṃ dang 'di gnyis su dar ba dang gnas pa 'di cis kyang gal che bas/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i rnam gzhag rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'gros bzhin du/ gzhan phyogs kyi grub mtha' dang ma bsres pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad dgos/ spyir sngags dang*/ khyad par gsung ngag rin po che/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bgros bzhin du bshad nyan mdzad na/ bstan pa spyi sgos la phan zhing*/ byin rlabs che zhes gsung ba mdzad nas/ dgun stod brag dkar mo'i gnas nyi ma dro zhing chu 'jam par dgongs pa la/ grog mkhar bas spyan drangs/ gtso bor ni gal che ba re re tsam ma gtogs sku mtshams dam por bsdams hor zla bcu gnyis pa de'i yar ngo la sku khams cung zhig snyel nas zhag gsum song ba la/

rkong po 'tsho byed pas phyag phyi byas steng thog tu byon/ phyogs bcur gzigs pa na/ nam mkha' la sprin dang*/ du ba dang*/ nyi zla dang glog la sogs pa mang por snang ba 'di/ lam gyi rtags yin nam/ nam mkha' rang la yod pa yin nam gsung*/ lam rtags de ci las 'ong ba yin/ zhus pas/ rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa las 'byung gsung*/ de'i rjes la ci yong zhus pas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'byung gsung*/ gzims mal du phebs nas dbon po rgyal don gyis na bza' zhus pa'i tshe/ bla ma so so'i na bza' rnying pa byin rlabs kyi rten du gnang ba rnams/ so sor ngos bzung nas de bsod nams 'phel ba'i na bza' yin pas thog mar sgron cig ces spyan snga rin po che'i na bza' rnying pa dang*/ de byams dang snying rje 'phel ba'i na bza' yin pas sgron cig ces rje mus pa'i na bza' dang*/ de ni mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba brnyes pa'i na bza' 'o// zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi rnam sbyar la byin rlabs zhu bar mdzad do// spyir yang gzims dpon don grub pas gsung dus/ rang res lo bzhi bcu zhe bgrangs kyi bar phyag phyi 'bral med du bgyis pa la/ nang du yon tan brnyes tshul dang*/ lhag pa'i lha zhal gzigs tshul ni 'di 'dra yin zhes gsal po ye mi gsung*/ nga rang gis mthong thos kyi rnam pa la/ sngon lo sbrel gyi sgrub pa thengs gsum mdzad pa las/ dang po gnyis la bde dges kyi grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag re dang*/ sbyin bsreg khri tsho re tsam thengs/ de skabs su yang mig 'khrul byung gsung pa thengs mang po byung*/ bsam tshod la lhag pa'i lha re re tsam gzigs pa yin nam bsam/ sgrub pa rting ma'i dus su gtum mo dang lus sbyong la gtsor mdzad/ snga dro res kyis phrin las sum cu so gnyis po cha tshang ba rim can dang rim min gnyis ka grub rjes bde bas rgyal ba'i rnam pa yun ring du mdzad kyin 'dug de las ma sangs kyi bar du gsol ja mi bzhes/

'di lta bu ci yin zhus pas/ sems gnas pa na lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba zhes zer ba de yin la che gsung*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen brnyes pa yin nam zhus pas/ de ltar du khas mi len gsung*/ yang shangs khrag mang po bab pa'i dus shig tu/ a ka ru'i spos khyer shog gsung*/ shangs la bdug pas/ nam mkha'i thub pa gtso 'khor la phul gsung*/ gzigs pa yin nam zhus pas/ mthong ba don ldan gyi bris sku de la 'khrul pa red gsung*/ yang phyag phyi la 'khod pa mang po zhal 'cham par/ dkar po rgur gyi thang dkyil du gzims gur mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i srod tho rangs gnyis ka la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs lnga gzigs pa'i gsung nyams mang po rang byung bas/ gzigs thag chod na'ang*/ zhal bzhes mi mdzad pa ni khong pa rang gi chos lugs yin zhes zer/ brag dkar du bsnyung tshul de ltar bstan pa'i 'phro nyid nas/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs/ snga thun gyi thugs dam gyi rim pa rdzogs par zin nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams bde bar bskyod pa'i lam ni gsal po de nyid do// zhes thugs khar thal mo sbyar/ 'od gsal ba dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa nyid nas bde bar gshegs so// de ltar na/ spyir gsang sngags bla med kyi zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la mnga' brnyes pa/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la mchog tu gzhol ba rnams kyi nang gi yon tan/ khams 'du lugs dang*/ lta ba rtogs tshul dang*/ grub mtha' snyogs pa'i rim pa rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas na/ 'dir thun mong gi rnam par thar pa nyid du 'bri bar ga la nus/ de lta mod kyi/ phyi rol nas rgyal sras chen por mtshon pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ni/ 'di gang na bzhugs pa'i gnas der/ bza' btung dang mkho rgu'i yo byad thams cad char bzhin du 'bab/ phyogs kyi la sgo dang gser dngul la sogs pa'i sgo bye phyogs kyi grwa rgyun dang tshongs pa rnams bde bar slebs/

mtshungs med kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi zla lta bu dang*/ de sras skar ma'i tshogs rnams gsal bar byon zhing bde bar bzhugs/ de dag ni phyi'i mtshan ma yin la/ nang gi khyad par ni/ rjes thob kyi mdzad pa'i khyad par las rtogs par nus pa'i phyir na/ ji skad du/ sher phyin las/ sa dang po nas sa lnga pa'i bar yongs su sbyong ba'i rjes thob kyi mtshan mar gsungs pa de thams cad phyag bzhes su mnga' bar phal cher gyi mngon sum du grub pa nyid las shes so// skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs rnams kyi// blo mtsho'i me long dwangs pa la// rgyal sras sku gsung thugs rnams kyi// rang bzhin gsal bar snang mod kyang*// blo mtsho'i me long brnyogs pa na// thub pa skal med mig gi ni// lam du mi 'gyur ba de bzhin// de der gyur la mya ngan ci// nyi zla nub dang 'char ba yi// rim pas snang bar byed de bzhin// 'tshur nub rim gyis 'jig rten khams// phan dang bde bas gang bar shog /gnyis pa rjes kyi mdzad pa ji ltar grub pa ni/ de ltar rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su bde bar gshegs rjes kyi gza' tshes 'dzom pa'i dus su/ sku gdung gi snying po zhugs la zhen par gyur pa de'i tshe/ grub mtha' snyogs pa'i rtags su thog mar nam mkha' g.ya' dag zhing so sor gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du/ kha dog sna lnga dang ldan pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i sprin dang 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo rnam par bkra/ lha'i dbang po dang 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'i mchod 'os su gyur pa'i ltas su/ lha'i me tog gi char chen po nyin mtshan bco lnga tsam du sbrel nas babs/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung 'od zer lnga ldan tha ma mchog tu thim nas 'gyur med bde ba chen po brnyes pa'i rtags su/ kha dog rnam pa lnga'i 'od zer can gyi rings srel rin po che'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa grangs las 'das pa dag gsal por byon pa/

thog ma nyid nas bu slob so so'i rten skal du byon pa dag ni rtsod pa dang bral zhing bsam gyis mi khyab/ dus phyis nang rten gyi dbus su bzhugs pa dang*/ thag ring po'i rten skal du 'gyed mdzad kyi gdung tsha 'bum phrag tsam btab pa la/ gdung tsha re re'i tog tu ring bsrel yungs kar tsam byon pa ni shin tu mang zhing*/ lnga drug tsam dang*/ tha na'ang re re tsam ma byon pa ni ma byung bar kun gyi mthun snang du grub/ dgongs rdzogs dang gsol 'debs kyi rim pa/ gdung rabs gong ma rnams la phyag srol ji ltar yod pa bzhin dang*/ de las kyang khyad par du/ nā len+d+rar dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa khri tsho tsam bsags/ chos 'khor gyi gral dbu la/ ne'u thogs nas gling stod gdan sa ba chos rje nam mkha' brtan pa spyan drangs/ brgya 'bul chen po dang*/ tshogs pa gzhung ma la zho phyed re dang*/ phyogs bcu ba la bzhi nam re'i 'gyed rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dus kyi gzhir bzhag gtsang phyogs su gdan sa chen pos thog drangs/ sa skya pa'i mdo sngags kyi grwa sa chen po rnams su/ bla ma so so la 'bul chen dang*/ chos 'chad dag la rnam gzhag rgya cher mdzad/ shing pho khyi'i hor zla bzhi pa la/ nā len+d+ra'i chos rdzong dang 'dabs 'brel gyi sa'i 'bur/ sngon thugs sbyong mdzad dus nyin bar gyi bzhugs gnas nges pa can der/ dri'i gtsang khang ka chen gnyis pa/ khyams ka ba bcu drug dang bcas pa bzhengs/ der sku'i rten lam 'bras brgyud pa'i lha tshogs/ gsung gi rten sangs rgyas phal po che'i glegs bam tshang ma/ thugs kyi rten dngul gyi gdung khang mtho bcu gsum pa/ mchod pa'i yo byad shin tu dngos gtsang zhing rnam grangs mang ba/ rnam dpyod can yid 'phrog pa dag grub par mdzad do// sa ga'i nya la chos kyi rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang brgya phrag gcig gi 'khor dang bcas pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis rgya tsho'i stengs nas rgyas par bsgrubs/

'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dga' ston gyi rnam par bzhag pa rgya chen por mdzad pa'i stengs su bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis legs par bshad pa'i chos kyi 'gro ba mang po dang*/ mdo sngags kyi sgo du ma nas gleng bslang ba'i 'bel gtam gyi bka' mchid zhag grangs du mar sprel te mdzad/ dus de tsam nas bzung nas/ dus chen gyi steng du dkyil 'khor mang po bzhengs pa'i sgrub mchod/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur gya nom pa zung du sbrel ba zla dus tshang ba'i mang ja'i rim pa rnams tshugs/ dus ji srid pa'i bar du rgyun mi chad cing*/ lhun gyis grub pa'o// //swasti/ chos kun kun mkhyen gsung bzhin mkhyen pa'i sku// gzhan phan la dga' dga' bzhis phyug pa'i gsung*// thugs kyi rdo rje rje btsun gong ma yis// lung bstan bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bsngags par 'os// gang 'dir thub pa rnams dang sa skyong rgyal po'i sras ni 'bad mi dgos par lhun gyis grub ste ye shes dag dang bsod nams tshogs ni brgya phrag ngal bas bskrun min par yang yid bzhin mtsho ltar ngang gis gang*// thos dang bsam dang bsgom pa'i lam srol drang po nyid du rigs par rjes zhugs bslabs shing sbyangs pa'i spobs pa mi zad dang bcas rigs shing grol bar chad pa'i gsung gang gis ni 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bsdus// byang chub sems mchog bde bar rgyu ba'i lam chen nyid nas 'gro kun sgrol ba'i yab dang brtse ba'i yum chen nyid du nyer gzigs kun la phan dang bde ba'i byed por zhal gyis bzhes las dgongs pa gzhan mi mnga'// dus rnams dag tu thub pa'i bstan dang de 'dzin byed la bkur stir bgyis las mdzad gzhan mi 'tshal ji ltar dgongs bzhin bgrangs yas gdul bya'i rgyud la bdud rtsir smin mdzad de yang zab cing rgya che'i smon lam stobs kyis phrin las dbang por gyur der mgos phyag 'tshal// zhes rje btsun chos kyi rje kun dga' rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar pa dad pa'i stobs rab tu skyed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rje de nyid las gsung ngag rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa lan grangs du mar gsan nas/ thugs rgyud la smin par mdzad pa'i skabs su/ bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin par mdzad de/ lo grangs ji srid par rgyas btab ste/ skabs su bab pa'i dus de nas gsung ngag rin po che'i bsgrub brgyud mi 'chad par 'dzin po nyid du bka' bsgo brnyes pa/ rgya ma rin chen sgang gi mkhan chen kun spangs ngag dbang dpal 'byor bzang pos nan gyis bskul bar mdzad pa la brten nas/ rje btsun kun dga' mtshan can de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gyur pa dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ byang chub sems dpa' skal ldan shing rta'i sprul pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i khang bzang dam par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshon no// //maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan e waṃ dbyer med zung 'jug sku// bde stong longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis// thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par// 'khrid mdzad bla ma rnams kyis 'dir skyongs shig /sngon gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rdo rje 'chang chen po nas brgyud pa'i rim pa bar ma chad cing*/ lhad ma zhugs pa'i gdams ngag khyad par du 'phags pa mang po zhig byon zhing*/ 'grib pa mi mnga' bar bzhugs pa du ma dag las kyang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la rdo rje bdag med mas dngos su gdams pa'i gzhung*/ lam 'bras gsung mdo zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i sgo nas/ gdul bya lam la 'khrid tshul 'di kho na khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ 'di ni skal ldan cig char ba'i rigs can lta ci smos/ sngar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'jug ye ma myong ba'i gang zag skal ba dman pa'i rigs can zhig kyang*/ spyod pa rim can la slob pa dang*/ lta ba rim can la sbyangs pa mthar phyin gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i tshul dang*/ don de dag kyang chal chol dang lhod yangs su song ba ma yin par/

snyan brgyud bzhi dang*/ tshad ma bzhi'i rgya dam pos btab nas/ gzhi dam tshig dang sdom pa la legs par gnas pa'i steng du/ lam rim pa gnyis la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la mi g.yel zhing*/ lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa nyams su blangs pas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed pa 'chugs med ston pa dang*/ brtson 'grus tha shal du gyur pas kyang*/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas tshe gcig po la grub mtha' snyogs pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa ston pas so// de thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang mdo sngags thams cad kyi bla ma tshad mar gyur pa la rag las pa yin te/ de med na lta spyod rim can gyi tshul la slob pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams gang las byung ba dang*/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len dag mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// bla ma de yang gdams ngag gi go rim ma log pa dang*/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma gong ma dag gis ji ltar khrid pa bzhin du/ lam gyi rim pa de dag la go ba chags shing*/ nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa zhig dgos pa'i don yin gyi/ lung rgyun ma chad pa tsam gyis chog pa ma yin par shes pa'i don du thog mar bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar bstan nas/ mos gus kyi nges shes bskyed du 'jug pa ni phyag len gyi rim pa'o// de las kyang 'dir ni rje bla ma dam pa ā nan+da'i mtshan can yab sras gnyis ka las gsung ngag rin po che'i gdams pa rab tu thob nas/ sgrub brgyud ma nyams par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa rnam par dkar zhing*/ brtson 'grus chen pos phyag bzhes su mdzad pa'i rgyal sras glang ri thang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ba la gsum ste/ thog mar mngon mtho'i gong 'phangs brnyes nas mdo sngags kyi chos la bslab sbyangs ji ltar mdzad pa/ mdzad nas mdo phyogs la nyan bshad dang gdams ngag gi bsgrub pa ji ltar nyams su bzhes pa/

de ltar bzhes nas rgyud 'dzin gyi bu slob dag la lam gyi rim pa ji ltar mthar phyin pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul dang*/ rigs dang*/ yab dang*/ yum rnams ni rje gong ma nyid dang khyad par med la/ rje 'di nyid sa pho byi ba'i lo la sku 'khrungs pa na/ yab yum gyi lus sems bde bas khyab pa sogs ltas dang rten 'brel bzang po byung ba kho nar ma zad/ sgo mo rin po che bzang po dpal ba'i mnal lam du/ phyag 'khar gyi rtse mo mtho shos der/ nyi ma lhag gis shar ba'i tshe na/ dung phra sbom gsum phyogs su bus pa rmis/ 'di pa tshang la sde bdag khyad par can zhig 'byon pa'am/ nyi ma shar lugs la bltas na/ spyan snga kun rgyal ba dang 'dra ba'i rab byung zhig 'byon pa yin gsung par 'dug pa la/ yab drung chen gyi gsung gis/ rin po che bas de ltar gsung 'dug kyang*/ 'di lha spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la mdzub mo gtad nas ma ṇi zer gyin 'dug pas/ ma ṇi ba cig yong tshod du 'dug gsung la/ spyan snga rin po ches chos skyong la bka' bsgo mdzad nas/ mtshan chos skyong dpal ldan du btags/ de nas rang lo bdun pa la khu bo rnam gnyis kyi drung du dge bsnyen dang rab tu byung nas dge tshul du mdzad/ gnas kyi slob dpon rgyal ba phun tshogs la gtad nas/ tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa dang lnga bcu pa la bslab sbyang dang spyod lam gyi rim pa bslabs/ rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi gzhung la brgya tshar song rjes/ ka bzhi pa bsod nams seng ges mdzub khrid pa mdzad nas/ rong ṭīka gi spyi don tshig don mtha' dag thugs su chud pa dang*/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi gzhung byang chub par mdzad nas/ rgyal glang gnyis ka'i tshogs pa la chos gsungs/ bshad tshar gyi dga' ston dang rnam bzhag rgya chen mdzad/ de nas bzhugs pa'i mthil lo bcu tsam gyi ring la nā len+d+ra nyid du mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du rgyan rtsa 'grel/

bshes spring*/ dbu ma rigs tshogs tshad ma rigs gter la sogs pa'i gzhung chos mang po dang*/ phar phyin khrid yig zhi byed/ nī gu la sogs pa'i khrid phran dang*/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes snang*/ 'bum ṭīka chung ba sogs bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung gsan/ lung ra chen mo'i sgrigs su lan 'debs mdzad/ chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal ba la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi gzhung ṭīka tshar gsum byang chub par mdzad/ rtags rigs sogs kyi zin thun thugs la bzung*/ rigs grwa'i khrod du 'jug pa la nyams nga ba dang bag tsha ba med pa mdzad/ gzhan yang bla med kyi dbang bskur mang po dang*/ rdor dbyings dang*/ chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sogs yo ga'i dbang bskur kha cig gsan/ mtshan nyid la thug sbyong mdzad pa'i bar skabs rnams su/ 'od gsal rtser spyan snga rin po che'i drung du/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang*/ chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang sogs/ gang la gang 'tshams rin po che nyid kyis dgongs pas dpyad nas gnang zhing gsan/ rang lo bcu gsum pa tshun chad du/ spyan snga phun tshogs pa'i drung du nyin re bzhin phar tshad bsdus gsum gyi 'gro gleng zhu/ sa sde lnga dang*/ bka' gdams gzhung drug la sogs pa'i lung dgongs pas dpyad nas gnang ba ltar gsan/ rang lo bcu drug bcu bdun pa la glang ri thang du dbyar dgun gyi dus chos gsungs/ bco brgyad pa la glang ri thang gi khri thog tu phebs/ chos rje bkras rnam pas khri ston gyi mang ja dang rnam gzhag rgyas pa mdzad/ bstod bskur bsngags gsum gyi snyan ngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa bsgrags pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' dwangs par yod kyang*/ de ma thag tu sprin bsdus/ 'brug sgra phyogs bcur gsal ba dang*/ char chen po babs pas ltas dang rten 'brel bzang bar gyur/ de skabs nas bzung ste/ lo grangs bzhi bcu tham pa'i bar la gdan sa mdzad/ dgon pa'i dar rgyas sngar las sum 'gyur gyis che/

mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan shin tu dar/ rten gsum bzhengs pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang rnam pa gsum bzhengs pa sogs phyag rjes shin tu mang po mdzad/ de skabs shig tu/ rgyal lha khang gi gdan sa lo gsum mdzad/ chos grwa de'i sgrigs dang rnam par bzhag pa/ rnam thar dang tshugs/ sgrub mchod/ dbyar dgun gyi dus chos dang*/ chos gzhi bteg pa rnams kyi skabs su phar phyin rtsa 'grel rgyal 'gros kyi stengs nas ma chag par tshar re gsungs pa dang*/ rigs grwa dang lung grwa'i sgrigs 'cha' ba la thugs rtsol shin tu che bar mdzad do// skabs der zho lung mtsho kha'i bsgom grwa phyag tu byung ba dang*/ gdan sa gnyis ka gcung yon tan rgyal mtshan pa la gtad/ rang lo nyer bzhi pa shing mo phag gi lo la/ rje ngor pa chen po'i kun spyod kyi rnam par thar pa dang*/ phrin las kyi rnam par dkar bas thugs rab tu phrogs te/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par hor zla bdun pa la phebs/ lo dus kyi gsung ngag sgang yol tsam du song yang*/ spyan snga ba gsar du phebs pa'i dpon slob rang la gsung ngag gsar du 'dzugs/ da bzod kyi gsung ngag la sgugs bzhugs mdzad/ de bar la chos gzhan gsan pas khyab gsung bar 'dug kyang*/ da bzod kyi lo la 'gal rkyen ci 'ong mi shes gsung nas/ gsung ngag btsugs/ hor zla bcu pa la gzhung bshad gnang zin tsam gyis dus su/ rje rin po che spyan rab rib tu gyur pa dang*/ sku mtshams dam du bsdams/ spyan snga ba 'dir re shig la chos mang po 'chad dka' bar 'dug pas/ slob dpon dkon rgyal ba la 'di pa'i chos lugs thugs bzhed yod pa rnams gsan na legs gsung pa phebs/ ji ltar bka' gnang ba bzhin/ gdan sa'i gnas mjal/ bdag po gzhi thog pa'i drung du chos gsan pa sogs mdzad nas/ mus bde ba can du thegs bde dgyes gsang gsum dang 'brel pa'i dbang lung man ngag gsan pa rgya che zhing thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs pa'i skabs su/

e waṃ du byi ba lo hor zla bzhi pa'i nang der/ rje rin po che bde ba can du gshegs pa'i dgongs pa mngon du mdzad nas/ sems dpa' chen po gdan sar spyan 'dren byung pa dang dpon slob chabs cig par e waṃ du phebs/ der yang gsung chos kyi bzhed pa rnams re shig grub par mdzad nas/ brtse chen du mkhan chen dkon mchog bzang po'i drung du/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i nyams khrid ngo sprod cha lag rnams rdzogs par gsan/ byi lo de nyid kyi ston glang ri thang du phebs/ lo grangs du ma'i bar du chos sde de nyid dang*/ dben gnas so sor bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad/ phrin las dar zhing rgyas/ de nas rang lo so gcig pa chu pho rta'i lo la/ rje kun dga'i mtshan can dang*/ sku mched gnyis kas sngar ma gsan pa'i chos gsan pa dang*/ gsan zin gyi chos rnams la rtogs pa gong 'phel gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ gtso bor nyams myong gi rtogs pa gong 'phel la dgongs nas/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du bskyod/ lo gcig lhag tsam gdan chags/ slar e waṃ du phebs/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho la rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa rgyas pa sogs gsung chos mang du gsan/ spre'u lo la 'phan yul du phebs nas/ bshad sgrub sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa la bar chad med par byung*/ yang rang lo so bdun pa byi ba'i lo la rjes mus pa chen po la dad pa'i shugs dang*/ sngar ma gsan pa'i chos 'ga' zhig gi bzhed pa dang*/ gtso bor ni thugs g.yeng bskyungs pa'i bsgrub pa rtse gcig la nye bar gzhol ba'i dgongs pa sngon du gtang mus su phebs/ sgrub pa lung sbyin gsan nas/ de dang mthun pa'i sgrub pa dang nyams len 'phel po mdzad/ skabs de dang gzhan du'ang*/ bdag chen chu mig pa la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang bka' 'bum sogs mang du gsan/ gnas der sgrub pa la lo grangs mang tsam zhig gi bzhed pa mnga' yang*/ 'phan yul du yab drung chen bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyi rnam grangs mang po la brten/

phyir lam e waṃ du chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la zab chos mang zhig gsan nas phyir phebs/ de ltar gtsang phyogs su lan gsum phebs pa'i thog ma/ rang lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la/ rje sems dpa' chen pos mkhan po/ bdag chen chu mig pas las kyi slob dpon/ rje kun dga' rdo rjes gsang sde ston pa/ chos kyi rje don yod dpal sogs kyis kha skong mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs rjes su chos rje don yod dpal ba las/ gser mdog can du rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i 'bum ṭīka chen mo'i lung dang*/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' 'bum spod bzhi ma'i lung rnams gsan/ yang rje don yod dpal ba dang ram sdings mar 'dzom dus mdzad nas/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dmar ṭīka gi steng nas rgyas par gsan/ skyor chos dang skyong ran sogs zla ba gsum la rdzogs pa mdzad/ yang rje 'di pas rang lo nyer bdun pa'i skabs der rwa sgreng ka bzhi par grags pa'i chos rje rin chen bkra shis pa glang ri thang du spyan drangs lo gnyis su bzhugs/ rje gong ma'i rnam thar du brjod zin pa ltar/ dbang rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa la sogs pa skyar chos dang*/ rtsis yan chod la bslab sbyangs dpyis phyin par mdzad/ rje kun dga' rdo rje ba las kyang*/ rgyud 'bum 'dul ba lung*/ bla ma gong ma'i bka' 'bum dang*/ dbang rjes gnang mang du gsan/ bdag po mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug glang thang du spyan drangs nas/ dbang bka' mang po dang chos skyong gi rjes gnang dang*/ man ngag mang du gsan/ rje stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa las/ bde mchog 'jigs byed la sogs pa'i dbang kha cig dang*/ dwa ha bskor gsum/ nā ro ni gu'i chos drug dka' brgyud gser phreng la sogs pa dgas po dka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab grags che ba mang du gsan/ bdag chen chos kyi rje blo gros pa dang*/ chos rje gung ru ba las kyang*/

bde mchog nag po pa'i chos skor gsan/ mdor na rje 'di pa rang lo so bdun pa yan chad du gsan pa dang bslab sbyangs rgya che zhing*/ chos bshad dang bsgrub mchod kyi gtso bor mang du mdzad/ so bdun pa nas zhe dgu pa'i bar sngon nyid nas thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la mi g.yel ba'i steng du yang ches cher nan tan du mdzad nas sgrub pa nyams len gtso che/ lo re la lam 'bras zla gsum ma dang*/ bka' 'bum so so'i lung re tsam gnang ba mdzad/ de dag gi skabs su sa lam gyi yon tan dang ye shes brnyes tshul/ lhag pa'i lhas zhal bstan tshul sogs ni/ rgyun du ba'i nyams len gyi mdzad tshul sogs dang*/ gnas skabs so sor sgrub pa la lo grangs tshang bar bzhugs tshul sogs la dpags na khyad par can mang po mnga' bar snang mod/ phyi ltar du mi gsung bas bri bar ma nus so// de ltar mngon par mtho ba'i go 'phang mchog tu gyur pa brnyes pa'i ngang nyid nas/ lo grangs mang po mdo sngags kyi bslab sbyangs mang po pa dag dang*/ rang lo nyer bzhi pa nas bzung ste/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog la nyi ma gcig kyang mi g.yel ba'i sgrub pa dang*/ dad pa dang blo gros mchog tu gyur pa'i slob ma mang po la dbang dang*/ lung bshad mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas/ kun gyis bkur bar 'os pa'i bshes gnyen chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i skabs der/ rang lo lnga bcu pa lcags mo glang gi lo la/ sa skyong chen po don yod rdo rje dpon blon/ sde pa mang po'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ shrī nā len+d+ra'i chos grwa chen por byin rlabs zhu ba dang*/ rnam bzhag rgya chen po sgrub pa la phebs pa'i dus dang*/ gnas skabs rten 'brel bsgrigs/ sde dgon pa mtha' dag bka' bgros rtse gcig pa nyid du gyur nas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyi gdan seng ge'i khri la spyan drangs te/ mi che dgu mtha' dag tshogs/ rnam gzhag gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bsgrigs shing spungs nas/

bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i me tog gi phreng bas mngon par dbang bskur ba nyid du mdzad do// 'di ni phrag dog sprin tshogs las// rnam grol nyi ma gsal po ni// zhe sdang sgra gcan kha rlangs kyis// ma sgribs zla ba ji bzhin du// lung mang gsan pa rgya che ba// de nas kyang ni gzhung mang la// bslab sbyangs mthar phyin dben par ni// rtse gcig sgrub pa de ya mtshan// de ltar mang du gsan pa dang*// tshul bzhin du bslabs pa dang*// rnal 'byor mchog la goms pa phul du phyin pa'i stobs kyis/ chen po'i go 'phang ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul brjod zin nas/ gnyis pa mdo sngags kyis chos ji ltar gsungs pa dang*/ de'i mthu las bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ brgyud 'dzin gyi bu slob ji ltar byung nas bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i mthu grub pa'i tshul rnams brjod par bya ba las/ dang po ni/ gdan sa chen po de'i khri thog tu phebs nas/ dbyar dgun gyi chos dus gnyis po la/ mtshan nyid theg pa dang 'brel pa'i chos kyi nyan bshad mi nub cing gong 'phel gyi rgyun la phan par gyur cig pa'i dgongs pa nye bar bzhag nas/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel/ rnam bshad tshig don rab tu gsal ba'i grwa ma nyams pa tshar re/ chos dus gnyis la rdzogs par gsung ba dang*/ tshad ma rnam 'grel dang*/ rigs gter sngar gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i rnam bshad kyi steng nas ci grub re gsung ba dang*/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ phar phyin gyi khrid yig dang*/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba rnams kyi le'u so so nas ji ltar 'tshams pa re gsung bar mdzad do// gdan sa ji tsam mdzad pa'i ston dpyid kyi chos la gsung ngag rin po che tshar re re cis kyang ma chag par gsung ba'i stengs su/ res 'ga' rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya rtsa dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ yo ga rdor dbyings dang*/

dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen dang*/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs dbang bskur rgya che ba dang*/ bde dges gsang gsum la sogs pa'i rab tu zab pa mang po slob ma'i grangs nges pa can la re mos kyis bskur bar mdzad pa dang*/ skabs gzhan du gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rim pa lnga pa dang*/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa dang*/ lam bskor phyi ma kha cig dang*/ nā ro dang nī gu'i chos drug dang*/ gzhan yang blo sbyong dang*/ khrid phran so so ba mang po dag don gnyer ba so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par/ dpe mkhyud med pa nyid du sbyin par mdzad pas na/ dam pa'i chos sbyin par mdzad pa'i slob ma'i tshogs yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho bzhin du gang bar gyur to// gzhan yang lung gi rgyun mi nyams par mdzad pa'i phyir du/ mdo sde dang 'dul ba lung dang rgyud 'bum dang*/ sa skya bka' 'bum dang*/ rje ngor pa yab sras kyi gsung 'bum dang*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bum ṭīka chen mos thog drangs pa'i gsung 'bum gyi lung ji ltar bzhugs pa rnams/ lhod pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis gsung par mdzad pas na chos sde chen po rab tu dar zhing*/ phyogs kyi tha gru mtha' dag nas bu slob kyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo bzhi ngang gis 'du ba bzhin du gyur par mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshul dang dus mchod kyi sa cha gsar du 'phel ba dang*/ dus mchod chen po'i mig ltos gong 'phel du mdzad pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang chen po dang*/ gzims khang chen mo dang*/ 'du khang gi stod tshar rnams gsar bzhengs lta bur mdzad pa sogs las stabs bsam gyis mi khyab pas na/ spyir glang thang pa sku mched dgon pa'i zhabs rtogs la bka' drin che/ ji srid gdan sa lo brgyad mdzad pa 'di'i ring sku mtshams zla re tsam sdom pa lta bu'i sos dal yang ma mdzad par/ dam pa'i chos nyan bshad kho nas dus 'da' ba'i dgongs pa bzang po nye bar bzung pas na/

lung rgyun dang bshad rgyun dang*/ gsung ngag sogs sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma skar ma'i tshogs tsam dar zhing rab tu rgyas par gyur te/ dus de tsam na sa skya pa'i chos don gnyer gyi mi che rgu mtha' dag kyang khengs dregs kyi yul du ma gyur cing*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi don du gnyer bas/ pad mo'i tshal du bung ba'i tshogs rnams sprin ltar 'du ba dang mtshungs pa kho nar ma zad/ lung rgyun tsam don du gnyer gyi blo gros gzhon nu ma dag kyang*/ bshes gnyen gang yang rung ba gzhan dag gi drung du ma bgrod par/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi drung du lhag par 'du bas so// de bas na/ lung bshad kyi rgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma phran tshegs su gyur pa rnams lta ci smos/ che btsun du gyur pa mang po dag bgrang bar ga la nus/ rje gong ma de dag gi chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin nus pa dag mdo tsam bsdu na/ gsang phu gling stod kyi gdan sa ba bsod nams legs mchog pa dang*/ sde snod 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa sogs chen po rnam pa bzhi dang*/ gzhung las dang 'chad nyan 'dzin pa'i slob dpon rnam pa gsum dang*/ nā len+d+ra nas bshes gnyen chen po nam mkha' snying po dang*/ nam mkha' bzang po sogs/ dus de dus su bzhugs pa'i nyan bshad pa bstan pa'i rgyun la phan 'dogs mdzad nus pa mtha' dag gis/ tha na'ang bla ma gong ma'i bka' 'bum sna re tsam ma gsan pa cig kyang med pa dang*/ rgya ma bya yul gyi mkhan po rnam pas gsung gi bsgrub brgyud bzung ba dang*/ stag lung thang pa'i mkhan slob chos gsum ji snyed pa bu slob du ma gyur pa cig kyang med pa dang*/ rgyal rong na nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rab sgang du lha yags dkon mchog grags/ sde snod 'dzin pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsung ngag gi brgyud pa gzung ba dang*/ spom 'bor du chos rje ra mdo ba sogs gsung ngag gi brgyud 'dzin gsum tsam byung ba dang*/

smar 'khams su a kar chos rjes kyang chos 'brel gsan zhing*/ bshes gnyen kun dga' zla ba dang*/ shākya blo gros pa gnyis kyis gsung ngag cha lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa bzung ba dang*/ slad nas kyang bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pas rgyud 'dzin du lung bstan pa mang zhig yod par mngon no// gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa'i sprul pa yin zhes/ rgan po dag 'di skad du gleng ba thos te/ bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa de ni bshes gnyen po to ba'i gsung gis/ glang thang pa rdo rje'i ming can 'di ni tshul rnam par dag cing*/ byang chub kyi sems rang shar du yod/ gzhan gyi don la skyo ngal med pas na bstan pa'i bdag po'o zhes dbugs dbyung bar mdzad cing*/ rdo rje gdan pa chen pos sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul par lung bstan/ khong pa rang gis kyang skye ba thams cad du dge slong gi dngos po 'dzin par dam bcas pas na/ dpal ldan lha mo mngon sum du byon nas dre'u'i sgra lhang lhang por lan gsum du bsgrags/ dus de srid du srung ma byed par khas blangs pa sogs che ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa des/ rang lo bdun cu la thug pa'i bar de srid du glang thang nyis stong lnga brgya dang*/ shar ba sum stong brgyad brgya gcig tu bsdus pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten bzhengs/ pu to bas gtso mdzad pa'i dge slong nyis stong tsam gyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ 'di skad du/ chos grwa 'di shin tu rgud par gyur pa'i tshe/ kho bo thangs gcig 'ong ba dag na yang shin tu dar te/ gling ri skyes dang 'brel bar gyur pa'i tshe thengs gcig 'ong*/ zhes pa'i gtam/ mchod rten gyi dkar chag yig ger bris pa dag na yod do// zhes rgan po kun gyis mthun par gleng zhing*/ rgud pa'i dus su 'byon pa de/

rin po che bzang po dpal ba'am/ lo ts+tsha ba shākya bzang po'am/ spyan snga rin po che gang rung zhes ngos 'dzin zhing*/ dar ba'i dus su 'byon pa de rje btsun 'di nyid do// zhes gsung pa dag thos so// gang ltar yang*/ glang ri thang gi chos grwa 'di rgud pa'i dus su 'khrungs nas/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i gang zag stobs po che ji snyed byon pa de dag bshes gnyen chen po des byin gyis brlabs pa'i sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi sprul pa nyid du gdon mi za bar nges so// gang ltar yang rung ste/ rgyal sras chen po dag tu mtshon par byed pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ rtag tu skyon rig pas khyim na gnas pa la mngon par mi dga' zhing*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' dag las sems bsrung ba dang*/ nam yang nges par 'byung ba la dga' zhing*/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba dag la gces spras su bya ba dang*/ skye bo mtha' dag la byams shing khong mi khro bas snyan par smra ba dang*/ bzhin gyi mdangs gsal bas gsong por smra zhing*/ yo byad kyi khyad par ci 'byor pa dag sbyin par spro ba ste/ chos 'di dag gang la yod pa de ni rgyal sras chen por mtshon pa'i chos thog mar dge ba ste/ de dag kyang rje btsun 'di la gzhon nur gyur pa'i dus nyid nas mnga' ba'o// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims nyin mtshan gyi thun bzhir len pa las mi g.yel zhing*/ rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa la mngon par dges pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dag klog pa dang*/ 'dris shing kun chub par byed pa la 'grus pa mi lhod pa dang*/ gzhan la tho mi 'tshams zhing*/ phrag dog pa dang*/ rang la khengs pa'i dug gis ma gos pa dang*/ dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson zhing*/ phyi nang gi bdog pa thams cad gtong bar zhugs pa dang*/ mang du thos pas ngoms mi shes shing*/ sems can gyi don la skyo ba spangs pa zhes bya ba 'di dag ni/

rgyal sras chen por mtshon pa'i chos bar du dge ba ste/ de dag kyang rje btsun 'di la mnga' ba'o// dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid sgo thams cad nas mnyes par byed cing*/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog las mi g.yel ba dang*/ thun mtshams kun du dam pa'i chos bshad pa la spro zhing chos spyod kyi rim pa dang*/ zab mo'i bzlas brjod la 'grus pa mi lhod pa dang*/ dman pa'i sa gnyis las ring du gol ba'i dben par spro zhing*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i mdzad pa dang ma bral ba nyid dang*/ rang gang la gnas pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs kyis gdul bya gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la skyo ba spongs pa'i phrin las yod pa zhes bya ba 'di dag ni/ rgyal sras chen por mtshon pa'i chos tha mar dge ba ste/ 'di dag gang la mchis pa'i sems can chen po de thams cad ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gdung 'tshob pa nyid du nges la/ de thams cad kyang rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid la mnga' ba yin no zhes rang gi myong bas mngon sum du grub pa'i shes rab kyis rnam par brtags shing*/ yid ches pa'i gnas su 'dres par byas nas/ phyis 'byung gi brgyud 'dzin dag la bla ma tshad mar bya ba'i gtam nyid du byas pa yin no// de ltar bstan pa rin po che'i bgyi ba dang*/ 'gro ba mang po phan pa dang dge legs su bya ba'i mdzad pa dag mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ rang lo nga bdun pa sa pho spre'u'i lo/ hor zla bcu pa'i yar tshes gcig la/ sngon glang ri thang pa chen pos thog mar byang chub kyi sems yun ring du sbyangs pa'i gnas ri skyes dmar po'i stengs der/ dus phyis dgongs pa sngon gtang gi dben gnas dge 'phel gyi mtshan can grub pa der phebs nas/ zhag shas bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rang gi ngang gis 'du ba'i khyad par can gyi nyi shar la/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang gis bde ba can du gshegs so// rgyal ba'i sras rnams sa yi phyogs// gang du bzhugs pa'i 'gro rnams kyi// blo mtsho'i chu gter rnyogs pa na// sku'i dkyil 'khor phrin las kyi// cha shas rdzogs par mi 'char ba// 'di la mya ngan mi bya ste// bshad sgrub rgyud 'dzin bu slob kyi// nyi ma gsal po rtag tu 'char// de nas sa mo bya'i lo hor zla bcu pa'i dus chen la/

sku gdung rin po che tsan+dan gyi zhugs la zhen par mdzad pa de'i tshe/ yul ljongs kyi skye bo rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshogs mang pos sa gzhi mngon par bkra zhing*/ lha'i tshogs kyis mngon par sprul pa'i me tog gi char chen po nyin mtshan du mar phebs/ kha dog sna lnga'i ring bsrel gyi tshogs lhug par byon pa grangs las 'das shing*/ gdung tsha btab pa la mar gyi gong bur yungs kar gyi tshogs gtams pa lta bur gyur pa ni grangs las 'das te/ ji skad du/ 'phags pa rnams kyi ring bsrel ni// bsod nams stobs las 'khrungs pa ste// lus can rnams kyi bsod nams rten// rgyun mi chad pa'i rgyu yin no// zhes gsungs pa de nyid do// de ltar sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i rjes kyi mdzad pa/ mchod 'bul dang sbyin gtong*/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten yin thang dang*/ phyi nang gi gdung rten dus chen gyi mchod pa/ zla dus kyi sgrub mchod rnams ni rje gong ma rnams kyi lam srol ji ltar yod pa bzhin/ dbus gtsang gi gdan sa che ba dang*/ zhing dag pa'i chos grwa rnams dang*/ yul ljongs kyi skye bo'i sbyin gtong sogs ji snyed pa/ gdung nye ba'i zhal ngo zhal bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ phyogs kyi tha gru na yod pa'i bu slob rnams kyis sngar srol dag las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa tsam du grub pa las/ bye brag tu nang rten rdo rje 'chang rgyab mtho bcu gsum pa/ bal po'i bzo gnas pa mkhas pas/ lta bas chog mi shes pa nyid du grub cing*/ nang bzhugs byin brlabs che zhing*/ rnam grangs mang ba dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad pa bsgrubs nas/ spyan dbye'i dga' ston gyi rim pa rgya che la byin chags pa/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur dang*/ me tog gi char la sogs pa ltas mang po dag dang bcas te lhun gyi grub par mdzad pa yin no// 'dir smras pa/

blo gros 'khor yug yangs pa'i sa chen 'dir// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan tshugs pa'i rtse mor ni// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i nor bu yis// dge legs char chen phebs pa'i bkra shis spyon// gang gi rang bzhin gnyen zhing gshin la khro mi mnga' bas log par gshe la'ang 'dzum mdangs bzang pos gsong por smra mdzad pa// nam du yang ni khrims dang thos pa'i rlom pas khengs par mi mdzad mtho dman yongs la phrag dog med par kun gyi dge la yi rang bas// mang du gsan dang bshes gnyen tshol la skyo ngal spangs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis ni mtha' yas yon tan tshogs rnams lhun gyis grub// dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon rdzogs sangs rgyas su lta byed mkhan de blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i// mdzad pa yin no de dang mtshungs pa gzhan dag gang nas mchis kyang gus pa'i yid kyis thal mo sbyor// zhes/ rje btsun chos kyi rje glang ri thang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam du bya ba mos pa'i stobs rab tu bskyed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi dbang lung dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ man ngag gi rgyun bzung nas/ sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin pa la mchog tu gzhol ba/ rgya ma kun spangs pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor bzang po dang*/ mang du gsan pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su gnas pa bya yul mkhan po rgyal mtshan mgon po ba sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ glang ri thang pa khu dbon mched dang bcas pa'i bka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ rgyal sras skal ldan shing rta'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i bya 'dabs su nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
